record.rationale: Task6764KT connects the actual Writer/Calc shared FontNameSelect to source FontNameBox sizing/paint and real acquired physical files. Browser metrics use exposed CSS weight/slant and actual local named-style metadata;unavailable native family,pitch,registered named style and local weight/slant remain unknown. Native FontList still owns comparison/duplicate rules;UTF8 document encoding is an explicit browser-device port. Only the retained file loads on demand. Actual cmap/maxp/head/loca and defined OS2 readers supply glyph coverage/capabilities. A private actual FontFace loaded from the same bytes supplies outlines without CSS family substitution or double synthetic bold/slant;the source logical family stays unchanged. Real private registrations are marked by WeakSet identity and excluded from later inventories. Ordinary JS/browser/React ownership releases only private FontFaces and prevents stale asynchronous publication;no native allocator/refcount/cache machinery is ported. Actual row Canvas uses source sample selection,readable-name eligibility,fitting,selection colors and current host color/resize events. Unknown bytes/unresolved collections/load failures keep a readable label;glyph support is never inferred from fallback widths. Native physical OS backend/default named-style resolution,variable/named-instance acquisition,full style dropdowns and native raster parity remain unverified.
responsibilities: Own the actual browser port consumed by production Writer/Calc font preview.
Preserve actual physical identity,readable unknown values and native JS/browser resource lifetime.
